# SCI-FLT-MATCHED_TO_SCI-NOI v0.1/r0.1

Status: exact boundary draft; no NOI realization or uncertainty route is
claimed available

Producer of transformation: `SCI-FLT-MATCHED`

Producer of realization population/meaning: `SCI-NOI`

FLT supplies the immutable resolved state and fixed Apply action for one signal
realization: parent compatibility predicates, template, output anchors,
`W_p`, `E_p`, `d_p`, `L`, `S_apply`, validity, numerical-profile identity,
failure policy, and generation. Every compatible NOI member receives exactly
that action; no Learn or Resolve step runs on a member.

NOI owns member generation, ensemble population, dependence, finite-sample
uncertainty meaning, lifecycle, and provenance. Fixed-state parity alone does
not prove that the NOI target covariance equals `C_parent`, represent physical
noise, or support `PRED-008`. Such equivalence requires separate authority.

An NOI-informed state update creates an immutable successor FLT generation.
Per-member relearning, incompatible parent facts, mixed generation, or changed
support/normalization makes the NOI companion unavailable or failed without
changing the signal estimand.
